Notes

Analytics and experiment tooling has to be stopped symmetrically. Blocking on one origin and not the other is itself a difference, and it is the kind that produces a confident, entirely wrong report.

An aborted subresource does not stop the page from reaching its loaded state, so a blocked tracker costs nothing but the band it would have drawn.
